children: SAYS IT CONTINUES TO EXPECT UNCERTAINTY AROUND CRITICAL MINERALS TARIFFS TO PERSIST

EXPECTS MUCH OF THE METAL ALREADY IN THE US PARTICULARLY THE MORE INDUSTRIAL METALS SUCH AS COPPER AND PALLADIUM TO REMAIN TRAPPED, WHILE PERIODIC INCREASES IN TARIFF RISK COULD ENCOURAGE FURTHER STOCKBUILDING
SAYS TIGHTENING IN AVAILABLE EX-US INVENTORIES CAME AS INVESTOR INTEREST BROADENED BEYOND GOLD INTO SILVER, PLATINUM, PALLADIUM, EVEN COPPER
SAYS WHILE INVESTOR DEMAND HAS SOFTENED AS THE MARKET NOW PRICES A FED HIKING CYCLE, IT EXPECTS MUCH OF THE METAL PULLED INTO THE US TO REMAIN TRAPPED THERE, LEAVING AVAILABLE EX-US INVENTORIES TIGHT
